_comment: Single source of truth for OpenClaw unit economics. Edit this, not code.
_min_net_comment: Floor derived from KDP's best case: $9.99 ebook nets ~$6.89. Setting floor at $6.00 admits that price point while rejecting genuinely weak margins.

kdp_ebook._tier_note: First matching tier wins. The 70% tier requires price within 2.99-9.99 inclusive. All other prices fall to 35%.
kdp_ebook._delivery_note: KDP deducts delivery cost only on the 70% tier.

kdp_paperback._print_note: US marketplace, black ink, white paper. Approximate. Verify against KDP printing cost calculator before trusting.

gumroad_digital._note: Gumroad takes 10% on Gumroad-discovered sales. Simplified.
gumroad_digital._floor_note: ADR-020: separate, lower profit floor than the global $6.00 (calibrated for KDP ebooks) — printables have near-zero marginal cost and this floor exists specifically to allow the president's approved $3-5 launch pricing (net $2.70-$4.50 at 90% royalty) while still rejecting near-zero prices. Decided explicitly by the president, not inferred.

gumroad_premium._note: ADR-024: $50-300 human+Claude-authored premium bundles (HIGH_VALUE_STRATEGY.md) — same Gumroad royalty rate as gumroad_digital, much higher profit floor reflecting real human authoring time, not the near-zero marginal cost of an automated printable.
gumroad_premium._market_realism_note: Overrides the global market_realism section (calibrated for KDP ebooks) — a curated 40-60 page premium guide is priced on expertise/curation, not raw page count. A genuinely short (<20 page) premium product is still capped at $50 as a sanity check, not exempted entirely.

gumroad_elite._note: ADR-027/ELITE_ASSET_DOCTRINE.md Tier 1 floor: $97+ (net $87.30 at 90% royalty clears this). Independent of gumroad_premium's $25 floor — Tier 1 positioning demands a materially higher bar, not the same one relabeled.
gumroad_elite._market_realism_note: A genuinely thin Tier 1 bundle (<15 pages, e.g. an AI Agent Blueprint) is still sanity-capped at $97 — the Tier 1 floor itself, not exempted from the check entirely.

kdp_ebook._reason: Any ebook priced in this band nets LESS per unit than a $9.99 ebook (which earns 70%), while also selling less. Strictly dominated. Break-even vs $9.99 occurs at $19.69.

demand_model._note: No sales data. Any price recommendation is speculation. Populate from finance_data.json once real sales exist.

market_realism._price_per_page_comment: A 12-page book priced above 12*this value is priced by profit-floor math alone, not by what a page count that thin can credibly justify to a buyer.
market_realism._short_book_comment: Books under short_book_max_pages pages are additionally capped at short_book_price_ceiling_usd regardless of the per-page ceiling above — a second, independent sanity check, not a replacement for the first.
